name: 60045 · Lake Forest, IL
findings: ZIP 60045 (Lake Forest) has 240 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60045 (Lake Forest) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60045 (Lake Forest) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
